snippet: Companies must submit a Request for Proposal (RFP) to procure something. Purchasing is the process of acquiring goods and services on behalf of the business. Purchasing can also involve issuing written contracts between buyers and sellers. Sourcing is when a business finds a supplier who can provide them with the goods or services they need at a reasonable price. Sourcing process includes every activity that revolves around identifying and assessing potential suppliers as well as selecting and engaging with an appropriate supplier who offers the best value. At the end of the sourcing process, usually a contract is signed or an agreement is reached between the buyer and the supplier on what is to be procured and the terms of contract.
